dc:title: cabinets_dk
dc:description: cabinets_dk is provided as csv and rds file in /data/processed/. It contains information on coalition governments of Denmark, in particular a timeline including the parties that are part of each cabinet during the timeframe covered by the northatlantic_ft dataset. Refer to the documentation for more details.

columns.name: cabinet
columns.dc:title: Cabinet Name
columns.dc:description: ID for the cabinet, usually named after the head of government

columns.name: wikidata_id
columns.dc:title: Wikidata ID
columns.dc:description: Wikidata Identifier for the entity representing each cabinet

columns.name: bloc
columns.dc:title: Party Bloc
columns.dc:description: String identifying whether the government coalition belongs to the left (red) or right (blue) bloc of Danish politics, or is formed across blocs (across)

columns.name: type
columns.dc:title: Cabinet Type
columns.dc:description: String identifying whether the government is a single-party government (single_party) or a coalition government (coalition)

columns.name: DK_A

columns.dc:description: Boolean indicating whether Socialdemokratiet (A) was part of the cabinet
